text: しかし　ちゅうごくでは　このほうしを　かんぽうやくに　する。
note: かんぽうやく (kanpō-yaku) is Kampo, the Japanese form of traditional Chinese herbal medicine. It is an everyday thing in Japan, sold in pharmacies and prescribed by doctors.
claim: Kampo is the Japanese adaptation of traditional Chinese medicine, and Kampo remedies are sold in Japanese pharmacies and prescribed by doctors in Japan.

check.quote: Kampo is a Japanese traditional medicine with unique theories and therapeutic methods originally based on traditional Chinese medicine. … In Japan today, Kampo drugs for medical use are prescribed by licensed medical doctors while some are available at pharmacies and drug stores without prescriptions.
